subject: Quick confirmation needed
text: Hi, sorry to chase as the customer on this order, but I am about to step into another call and I still need one confirmation before I can move the warehouse labels through the billing system. Yesterday I asked you whether the updated instruction meant we should ship the two damaged cartons back to the supplier, keep them staged in the loading bay, or simply mark them on the returns sheet without touching the stock at all, and the reply that came through later only said the usual process, which is not enough for me to sign off. I do not want to guess because the audit trail has already flagged this order twice, and if we book the wrong action now we may have to reopen the whole delivery dispute next week. Please reply with a single word: return, hold, or document. If I do not hear back before four, I will assume the most conservative option, hold, and will note on the order log that no clear instruction was given. I know this was not your intention, but the email thread has become a maze and I have no time to untangle it while the driver is waiting. If there is a new version of the note that I missed, just forward the exact sentence and I will handle the rest. Thanks, sorry again for the hurry.
